caption: Two passengers sit in the back seat of a car when it brakes hard, and both are thrown forward against their seat belts.

sa.check: Two passengers sit in the back seat of a car.

pc.expect: The passengers' forward lurch begins with the braking and only then; before it they sit at rest relative to the seat.
pc.fail: The passengers pitch forward while the car is still cruising steadily; or they lurch with no braking visible at all; or one lurches long after the other under the same braking.

pc.expect: The lurch is toward the front of the car, the belts arrest it, and afterwards the passengers settle back into the seat.
pc.fail: The passengers are thrown backward into the seat or sideways; or they keep travelling forward past where the belt holds them; or they are flung out of the seat entirely.

pc.expect: The belts behave as inextensible straps: they go taut across the body, hold, and go slack again only as the passenger settles back.
pc.fail: A belt stretches far out like a rubber band; or hangs slack while the passenger is plainly pressing into it; or the belt goes rigid and stands away from the body.

pc.expect: Loose objects and hanging items in the cabin swing or slide forward at the same moment as the passengers.
pc.fail: Loose objects stay put or slide backward while the passengers pitch forward; or they move before the passengers do.
pc.precondition: Loose objects or hanging items are visible inside the car.

pc.expect: Passengers, belts and seats keep their number and shape and nothing passes through anything.
pc.fail: A passenger merges with the seat or with the other passenger; or a belt passes through a body; or a limb appears, vanishes or detaches; or a head passes through the headrest.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: Clothing colours, the car interior and the view through the windows stay consistent apart from the braking.
pc.fail: A passenger's clothing changes colour; or the seat pattern changes; or the outside scene jumps to a different place.

note: Inertia scene: the people are kept because their bodies are what shows the lurch. Facial expressions, seating posture and how hard the brake is applied are not judged; only when and which way the bodies move.

pc.expect: The mic's colour, the stand's height and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The mic changes colour; or the stand changes height; or the background changes.

note: The tapping hand is a trigger and is not judged.

caption: The figurine on a wind-up music box turns slower and slower as the spring runs down, and finally stops.

sa.check: A wind-up music box with a figurine on it.
The figurine turns.
It slows down.
It stops.
The slowing is gradual over the clip.
Turning, slowing and stopping happen in that order.

pc.expect: The turning only slows, never speeds up, eases to a stop and then stays still.
pc.fail: The figurine speeds up; or stops and starts again; or reverses direction; or jerks forward in steps.

pc.expect: The figurine turns about a fixed axis on the box, and the box stays still.
pc.fail: The figurine drifts across the box top; or the box slides; or the figurine's base separates from the box.

pc.expect: The figurine stands upright on its stand and the box rests on its surface.
pc.fail: The figurine floats up; or leans and hangs with nothing holding it; or the box lifts.

pc.expect: The figurine is rigid and holds its pose while turning.
pc.fail: The figurine's arms or skirt change pose while turning; or it stretches; or the box lid bends.

pc.expect: One figurine, one box; nothing passes into the box.
pc.fail: A second figurine appears; or the figurine vanishes; or sinks into the box; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The figurine's colour and the box's decoration stay the same.
pc.fail: The figurine changes colour; or the box's pattern changes; or the box changes colour.

note: The spring and mechanism are inside the box and need not be visible; the slowing is judged on the figurine alone.
